_notes.source: Live https://uprofit.com/day-programs read in Chrome on 2026-10-20 (Day Soft and Day Flex, every size) - prices unchanged; Google Maps. Earlier sources listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: Monthly subscription, renews every 30 days until you pass or cancel. standard = crossed-out price, promo = price shown with the site's 40% discount already applied (no code needed). The help centre lists the same full prices (e.g. Soft 50K $130, Flex 50K $147). For the 7th anniversary, code UPTBDAY gives 20% extra off on top; not applied here.
_notes.rules_detail: Soft and Flex share targets, drawdowns and contracts; Soft has a daily loss limit (trading resumes at the next session), Flex has none ('Daily loss limit: NO'). Evaluation consistency 50%, funded ('Live Virtual') consistency 40%. Drawdown trails up to the starting balance and then stops (e.g. 50K starts at $48,000 and updates up to $50,000); the help pages don't say whether it trails intraday or end of day. No activation fee. Swing trading between sessions not allowed. 10K accounts allow 5 micro contracts (no minis), so max_contracts is null there.
_notes.payout_caps: Per payout on the Live Virtual (funded) account: $300 / $1,500 / $3,000 / $4,500. Withdrawals only above a threshold (starting balance + safety net).
_notes.profit_split: 90% to the trader on Soft and Flex Live Virtual accounts (help centre).
_notes.fee_refund: Terms: 'All Sales are final, there are no refunds.' Recorded as false.
_notes.not_listed: UProfit DAY, ONE 50K and the Legacy programs are not listed; the homepage now sells Soft and Flex as 'DAY Program 2.0'.
_notes.company: UProfit Trader, a Delaware LLC (terms), 8 The Green, STE B, Dover, DE 19901 (footer; a common registered-agent address). 'Funding Since 2019' on the homepage.
_notes.vetting: Checked 2026-10-11. Trustpilot 3.3 from 6,540 reviews; few recent reviews (newest 23 Aug 2026), 3 of 19 describing a refused payout. Site live with current pricing. Passed. The site describes its simulated account as 'risk-free'; we don't repeat that.
_notes.marketing_stats_excluded: Payout counts, average payout and the published pass rate are not reproduced.
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official UProfit page we could read.
_notes.max_contracts_10k: The 10K cards (2026-10-20) list profit target $800, daily loss $220, 50% consistency and $400 drawdown but no contract limit, so max_contracts stays null for 10K.
_notes.affiliate_program: No affiliate or partner program found on UProfit's official pages (site search 2026-10-20). Ask UProfit directly if needed.
_notes.company_check: Google Maps search (2026-10-20) found no UProfit listing.

firm.name: UProfit
firm.about: UProfit is a futures prop firm that has run evaluations since 2019. It sells monthly-subscription evaluations in two versions, Soft (with a daily loss limit) and Flex (without one), from $10K to $150K, traded on TradingView or Tradoverse.

countries.notes: Users from these countries aren't accepted.
